title: Core Framework Overview
summary: This module encompasses the fundamental building blocks of CrewAI, including agent and crew orchestration, task and flow management, LLM integrations, event and state management, and a suite of core utilities and extensions. It provides the essential infrastructure for building and running intelligent agent systems.

nodes.label: Agent & Crew Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent & Crew Management
nodes.description: Manages the execution, interaction, and lifecycle of individual agents and collaborative crews, including tool usage and agent adapters for various LLM frameworks.

nodes.label: Task & Flow Management
nodes.title: Workflow & Task Orchestration
nodes.description: Defines, orchestrates, and manages complex AI agent workflows (flows) and individual tasks. It handles state persistence, human-in-the-loop interactions, and flow visualization.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: Large Language Model Integration
nodes.description: Provides abstract and concrete interfaces for integrating with various LLM providers (e.g., Anthropic, Azure, Gemini). It handles message formatting, tool calling, streaming, and token usage tracking.

nodes.label: Event & State Management
nodes.title: Event Bus & State Persistence
nodes.description: Manages system-wide events, their emission and processing, and tracks application runtime state. This includes checkpointing, event records, and A2A communication events.

nodes.label: Core Utilities & Extensions
nodes.title: Framework Utilities & Hooks
nodes.description: Offers a diverse set of utility functions, project structure annotations, memory analysis, logging, streaming, and custom hook management for the CrewAI framework.

edges.label: Orchestrates Agents/Crews
edges.title: Flows Orchestrate Agents
edges.description: Flows define and orchestrate the sequence of tasks, delegating them to agents and crews for execution according to the workflow logic.

edges.label: Utilizes LLMs for Reasoning
edges.title: Agents Use LLMs
edges.description: Agents and their adapters interact with LLMs for generating responses, planning, and making decisions based on prompts and context.

edges.label: Emits Agent Events
edges.title: Agent Activities Generate Events
edges.description: Agent activities, such as tool calls, task completions, and state changes, generate events that are managed by the central event bus.

edges.label: Uses Tools & Hooks
edges.title: Agents Leverage Utilities
edges.description: Agents leverage various utility functions, tools, and custom hooks for enhanced functionality, logging, and structured output.

edges.label: Uses LLMs for Feedback/Guardrails
edges.title: Flows Use LLMs for Control
edges.description: Flows may use LLMs for interpreting human feedback, validating content, enforcing guardrails, or making routing decisions within the workflow.

edges.label: Emits Flow Events & Persists State
edges.title: Flows Interact with Event/State
edges.description: Flows emit events for lifecycle changes, state transitions, and rely on the event and state management system for persistence and checkpointing.

edges.label: Uses Serialization & Memory
edges.title: Flows Use Utilities
edges.description: Flows utilize utilities for state serialization, memory management, and other helper functions to maintain context and structure.

edges.label: Emits LLM Call Events
edges.title: LLM Calls Generate Events
edges.description: LLM interactions trigger events (e.g., before/after call, token usage) that are managed by the event bus for observability and custom reactions.

edges.label: Uses Hooks & Output Validation
edges.title: LLM Integrations Use Utilities
edges.description: LLM integrations use hooks for pre/post-processing of calls and utilities for structured output validation and message formatting.

edges.label: Logs & Traces via Telemetry
edges.title: Event System Uses Utilities
edges.description: The event system integrates with utilities for logging, telemetry, and tracing application activities, providing insights into execution.

edges.label: Uses LLMs for Memory Analysis
edges.title: Utilities Leverage LLMs
edges.description: Memory analysis utilities leverage LLMs for intelligent processing and consolidation of memory records, enhancing agent context.

groups.label: Core Orchestration
groups.title: Agent & Workflow Core
groups.description: The central components responsible for defining, executing, and managing AI agents and their collaborative workflows (flows) within the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: Foundational Services
groups.title: LLM & Event Infrastructure
groups.description: Provides essential underlying services, including seamless integration with various Large Language Models and a robust system for event handling, state management, and checkpointing.

groups.label: Support & Extensions
groups.title: Framework Utilities & Hooks
groups.description: A comprehensive collection of helper functions, project structure annotations, memory analysis tools, logging, streaming capabilities, and custom hook management to extend and support the core framework.
